notes.title: Holiday patch in the making!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25177104/135fad6094c42c7b40d70a6161ae6213bf71673d.png

Hey all!

We're aware of some issues with save and load, and are working on a good patch on that. If you have heavy time invested in a piece, we for now recommend doing an extra export before saving, also recommend saving to use "save as" to have a few revision files to avoid loss of work.

This stability patch will be the first one on offer, while the patch following that will contain more updates to interface and tool feel.

Stick with us and enjoy sculpting through the holidays!

notes.title: Another big update on stability and user experience
notes.notes:
The changes in this update are too numerous to mention in full, but for an overview:

 Fixed some of the most problematic errors relating to undo and multiobject
 Simplified menu interaction further, adding options like grab button and "tractor beam" interactions
 Upgrades to desktop interface
 Fixed some more import, load and save bugs
 Improved precision on indicators


Kodon is ALWAYS open to input and feedback! Join us at Discord and tell it to our face what we should change!

notes.title: Major update before V1.0 Release
notes.notes:
We would like to announce that we are on the homestretch of releasing KODON in its full glory. 
Working hard days and nights to present you with “The New Way of Sculpting”, our v1.0 is just around the corner. In the meantime, you now have a chance to get  KODON at a significantly discounted early access price.

This version is our biggest upgrade yet!

notes.title: Kodon V1.0 release postponed
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

I just wanted to come in here to let you all know that because of unforeseen situations we've had to postpone the release of V1.0, which will still be ready for everyone by Christmas time because we want to ensure that we have a solid build for you. 

We will also be participating in the Steam Winter sale, so you get the chance to buy Kodon with a discount! 

We're sorry about the delay, but we hope it will give us the time needed to provide you with a version of Kodon that you can be satisfied with. 

Have a good day!

Brianda <3

notes.title: Major Kodon update: GPU based tools and Multiresolution
notes.notes:
Hi there Kodon enthusiasts! 

Like mentioned on the title, we have changed the way Kodon fundamentally works, trying to make a significant improvement on performance by utilizing the power of the GPU. 
The sculpting process now takes place here! 

Here's what you can expect in regards to changes:

 Multiresolution
 GPU Accelerated sculpting tools (Tool speed is ALOT faster, this is the biggest improvement)
 Brush Feel Greatly improved (Our second biggest improvement)
 Improved Lighting
 FBX, OBJ Import export improvements (vertex color)
 Insert Mesh brush (Great for concepting)
 UI improvements, including object naming (another update with bigger changes here is expected to be ready very soon)

This update has unfortunately still some issues in the following criteria:

 Remesh
 Conversion
 Symmetry
 Multiresolution
 Model Room is mostly unchanged: no changes on UI or bugs in this room.

Cloth Sim is currently unavailable in this update as we restructure Kodon and we hope to fix these issues in following builds, however, if you opt into the previous_version branch you can find cloth there.

Please give this a try and send any feedback that you may encounter our way. Don't hesitate to let us know everything: from bugs and aspects that are unintuitive to the things you love from this version so we know not to mess with them! 
Write to us here on the discussions or on any of our Social Media platforms. We'll try to engage as much as possible. And one thing, if you like this update, please let others know so in the reviews! Help us spread the word that Kodon is growing! 

Have a great week everyone! 

Brianda <3

notes.title: New update: Improved Remesher and Array function
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

Array functionality is out now in the Model Room as well as a more stable Remesher, about 4x faster, and with better topology!

Some of the known issues are still there unfortunately, including stamps and stamp orientation, but we'll get them fixed! Other problems you can expect:


 Still some heavy lag after remeshing to a high resolution :(
 Some  problems with Symmetry and Undo.


When it comes to important fixes, progress has been made in the modeling room like the disappearing polygons and Chamfer issues. Other fixes you can expect:


 Vertex Paint improvements (Not available from Paint room yet, you will find this in the Sculpt room for now)
 Inflate ALT functionality
 Square Brush in Voxel room is fixed
 Various bug fixes
 Native Windows File Dialogue Box in Desktop 


Please let us know if you experience any VR set up compatibility with this build. We have tried to fix some of the issues we had with the Valve set up, but it's always great to have it confirmed by you. 
Don't hesitate to let us know of any other problems you encounter, it really helps us!

Last but not least, please remember that we're still developing Kodon and some bugs are to be expected. Save your projects responsibly to avoid any big loss of work. 

Share your work and tag our social media so we can have a look, and don't forget about the Halloween Challenge taking place across Facebook, Instagram and Twitter :)

Facebook
Instagram
Twitter
YouTube

Thanks for the help and enjoy your weekend! 

Brianda <3

notes.title: New bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thank you to our community for letting us know about a few things that escaped us in the last update.
Here are the bug fixes you can expect this week: 


 Primitive input values bug 
 Trigger blob in Volume room
 Voxel export


It's a small list, but we are working on exciting things that will come your way soon, and once we have those in place our focus will be directed into fixing all the remaining bugs. 
UV map support was required by some of you, It's not ready yet, but it's coming :)

I hope you have a great weekend! 

Brianda <3

notes.title: A little update
notes.notes:
Hey there everyone! 
It's Brianda here with a little update. 

We're still working on some of the major features and bugs. I will keep you informed on how things develop.
In the mean time, this week we have a few changes:


 UX improvements
 Minor bugfixes


There's also a few additions to the tutorial, like how to undo and redo. We got feedback about this and we set out to fix it as soon as possible. 
We're also working on implementing an array modifier to the Model room. I will keep you informed on how this progresses.

We will be going into a phase in the development in which we will be spending a lot of our time testing and coding. The weekly patches might become more spaced out. I will give you some updates along the way on any improvements that might be coming your way! 

If you're using Kodon in the meantime, please share your creations and tag us on social media! 

Instagram
Twitter
Facebook Group

I hope you all have a great week!

notes.title: New Patch 17.06.2020
notes.notes:
Hi, It's Brianda here again!

Just wanted to give you guys a quick update on the changes you will find on this week's patch here on Steam.

Main changes / fixes: 


 Enhancements on mesh Line Sketch
 Some symmetry bugs in sculpt room have been fixed
 Save project now overwrites instead of making new file. 
 Improved tool tips


Main Bugs: 


 Light lock in VR still has some issues
 Hand held VR menu can't shift between tabs yet. 
 Modeling Room general bugs (Connect creates problems)


Please let us know of any major issues that have maybe escaped our attention, we learn along the way with your help! 

Have a great weekend!

notes.title: New patch is out!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Kodon's new patch is out and this is a little update of what you can expect when it comes to new features and changes, as well as bugs that remain and we're still working on.

Main features:


 Lock light: allows you to have the light attached to your head so it is always facing your object as you work on it (It can be disabled).

 Voxel noise and surface trace: New abilities to manipulate voxels.

 Faceted wireframe sculpting: A more informative and clear view of what happens during sculpting.

 PBR Materials/surface: More realistic and informative materials and reflections. 

 Undo: Some of the problems with this have been ironed out. 



Main Bugs:


 Undo still has some persisting issues

 Remesher still needs some work. It can sometimes be triggered by accidentally accessing it with the radial menu (this can cause some unexpected lagging), it can also cause spikes and disappearing mesh. 

 Model Room  still needs more work

 Poly count in the sculpt room can struggle a bit if the number is too high. 

 Imprecise sliders in VR. 


We're still trying to fix all the bugs as fast as we can, but sometimes things get broken in the process of fixing others. No worries though, we're on top of it and with your feedback trying out the newest patches we will get there! 

Let us know what you think, problems you encounter and things that you would like stayed the same. 

Brianda :)

notes.title: New Version Is out on the Main Branch
notes.notes:
Hi

We just wanted to announce that we have released a new version to the main branch.

We solved the most breaking issues with load and save so we thought we would just move it from the beta to the main branch since it is a much better build than the previous one. 

This way more people are will be trying it out and we will get more relevant feedback from everybody.

To those of you still on the beta branch, be prepared for getting some rapid updates, it might become more unstable at times so if you want a more stable experience remember to switch to the main branch.  

Check out our previous announcement for more info on the features added and what bugs that may be lurking.

Here is a link to the forum post about the changes and bugs, if you do some testing we will be very grateful if you posted them in this thread.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/479010/discussions/0/1726450077669445047/

notes.title: Kodon v0.55 full version is live!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25177104/c930a414f9d4489b77353da684819e716e8238ed.png

NOTE: v0.55 in Kodon, an Early Access product, means in our terms we are about 55% done, expected v1.0 later this year. Each build should be seen as a "prealpha" for now. Thanks for your patience and support!

Change/Feature List:


 Undo/Redo
Fixed the undo/redo issues and crashes.
 New Undo History Slider
We added a new undo history slider that allows you to quickly scroll through your sculpting timeline.
 Menu rework
 New Voxel Save option
You can now save your voxelspace creations and load / keep working on them.
 New Environment ("InfGrid").
Simplistic optimized environment with an infinite floor and a neutral skybox.
 Ambient Occlusion.
Simple AO-effect that you can turn on off. PS: a little slow and unoptimized in this iteration.
 Voxel Engine Speed
We have reworked the voxel engine in order to improve draw speed, and you should notice a considerably smoother sculpting experience via the standard tools.
 Voxel Engine Capacity
We’ve also reworked the algorithm to increase the amount of voxels you can work with. At this point you are, in terms of detail, only limited by your memory and GPU.
 Memory and Optimization
We have reduced the memory footprint drastically with this version allowing you to draw massive models even with just 16GB of ram. And with a 1080 Ti we are reaching 10 million triangles before any “VR-breaking” slowdown.
 New: Improved Square Voxel Brush
We changed the Square brush, it is now able to rotate with your tool.

Known issues:


 At 8Gb setups, you can bottom out your RAM usage, possibly forcing a restart.
 Short lags will occur for some cases of memory allocation (when you have sculpted for a long while).
 There are occasional issues with .obj and ply import. The voxel save should be pretty safe.
 Some occasional artifacts (small dots and normal lines) on the models visible at low zoom levels.


Please report bugs and suggestions in the Steam forums. We will respond and give you tips to fix any issues, and all bug reports and suggestions are very useful to us!

notes.title: Welcome to Emil! ("ZBrush version" coming)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25177104/dd4f115ec6078dc56ee6466b6273a44379d2b619.jpg
Picture of Emil before his recent haircut

We're proud to announce our partnership with Emil Klingberg of North Pixel, a professional ZBrush and 3ds Max modeler. Emil will be working on product development and UX for Kodon, as well as testing and creating promo material.

Emil will start by overseeing addition of important ZBrush features such as Move, surface-locked sculpting and more. This should result in a version which specifically addresses the needs of ZBrush users, in the coming weeks.

This version will fix most of the bugs in the current branches, and introduce the gained functionality from the various branches. Apologies for the wait.

Emils has already played around a bit with Freedraw:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25177104/1ee957a49ae9adb8c77dbb47e97c3db15eefff6a.jpghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25177104/82aa8be226b3840fb674b61f02fc2b80c414b3b7.jpg

notes.title: On postponations & silence + some info on the coming update
notes.notes:
We have had some challenges with the algorithms and UX in the patch we are working on (non-stop..), this has caused some long weeks of just coding.

It really sucks not to have time to give updates, but we want to give proper answers to people, and when you have your head chock full of advanced algorithms that are not working properly, that is a bit tricky.

Our community contact was supposed to be the fix for that - she has been hindered from starting her work, but luckily, she is in place today!


What is coming:

1) A new approach to polygon mapping that gives you unlimited polygons to work with. (100% done)
2) A new and clever solution to making geometric-like shapes, and make rough sculpting easier. (70% done - here is an early screenshot with edge bugs - don't judge! http://imgur.com/a/vX5ID )
3) A new approach to mirroring that includes radial symmetry (30% done)
4) Saving, undo etc for the new functionality (0% done)

Most of the work is in point 1) and 2) All in all, the version is about 70% done. There will be some hefty work in the coming time. Our new ETA looks like next week.
